g.text: Observation context: heat, cold and service disruption
Resolved = verified service restoration; record unresolved, escalated and declined cases separately. Reopen recurring failures.

g.text: INDEPENDENT EVALUATION BEFORE SCALING OR ADAPTATION
Compare ordinary I32 with ordinary I32 + versioned PCP among consenting, approved Greek heat-pump cases.
Co-primary: occupied-room thermal exposure + household private burden; analyse by assignment where randomised.
